routes.edit: Every torch lights the floor tiles it can reach in at most 3 steps, walking up, down, left or right through floor tiles only (light does not pass through walls, water or doors).
Trailing whitespace is removed from each line (leading spaces are kept: they are tiles) and blank lines are skipped;
All sprites come after every tile in the SVG, which puts them on top.
